suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Resolution 2026 publishes this relationship only as infection neurologic complication. Require documented Lyme neuroborreliosis or otherwise clinically attributable neurologic Lyme disease and separately documented cranial nerve palsy, most commonly facial nerve palsy. Do not generalize to uncomplicated Lyme disease. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
evidenceGaps: Independent diagnoses of Lyme Disease and Cranial Nerve Palsy
Chronology compatible with the bounded source proposition
Assessment of shared risk factors, reverse direction, treatment effects, and other competing causes

Resolution of the publication guard: Require documented Lyme neuroborreliosis or otherwise clinically attributable neurologic Lyme disease and separately documented cranial nerve palsy, most commonly facial nerve palsy. Do not generalize to uncomplicated Lyme disease.
